items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bobby Hackett was going to be [lead trumpet], but see we made that movie... Bobby for one reason or other didn’t want to go out with a band.

ctx.x: How did you get that band together? What was the actual process? Did you pull some of the guys . . .

I picked the strings first. Strings you can get anywhere. I got a good string section. Then I knew Billy [Butterfield] would play lead [trumpet]. Bobby Hackett was going to be [lead trumpet], but see we made that movie, and Bobby did Scott . . . Burgess Meredith, and . . .
Which film was this? Second Ending?
